stem: A grower adds more aeration after seeing stressed roots but makes no other measurements. What is the better diagnostic approach?
choices: Measure root-zone temperature, dissolved oxygen where applicable, flow or saturation conditions, root appearance and system sanitation before assigning one cause
Assume every root problem is oxygen deficiency
Add nutrients until roots change color
rationale: Root stress can have multiple interacting causes; a measured diagnostic sequence is stronger than treating oxygen as the universal explanation.
